name: io.github.smeet666/mcp-bideetmusique
description: Search the Bide & Musique collection of forgotten French songs. Records, lyrics, no API key.

environmentVariables.name: BIDE_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Your application's name. The project identity is appended to it.

environmentVariables.name: BIDE_MIN_INTERVAL_MS
environmentVariables.description: Minimum milliseconds between requests. Default 3000, floor 2000.

environmentVariables.name: BIDE_CACHE_TTL_MS
environmentVariables.description: In-memory cache lifetime in milliseconds. Default 900000.

environmentVariables.name: BIDE_CACHE_MAX_ENTRIES
environmentVariables.description: Maximum entries kept in the in-memory cache. Default 200.

environmentVariables.name: BIDE_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: silent, error, info or debug, on stderr. Default error.
